learning_outcomes.text: Students can create three-dimensional (3D) solid models.
Students can examine the geometric properties of the parts and assemblies they design and modify their designs using the analysis and visualization tools of CAD software.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to contemporary CAD programs. Explaining of a CAD program interface.
Introduction to the sketcher. Basic sketcher commands. Object snapping properties.
Constraining of sketches. Visual settings. Analysis of the sketches.
Drawing of sketcher geometries. Editing of sketcher geometries. User selection filters.
Introduction to solid modeling. Part design. Creating of solid models based on sketch.
Converting from surface models to solid models. Transferring of solid models. Boolean operations.
Adding of new part to part environment. Activating of the part. Defining the axis.
Assigning of dimensional and geometrical constraints between solid models.
Introduction to assembly design. Adding of a new part to assembly. Introducing of feature tree.
Translating and revolving of parts. Assigning of constraints between parts on the assembly.
Implementation of analysis methods of the assembly. To assign material. Adding of the standard machine components to model. Updating.
Opening of drafting module. Creating of sheet. View extraction from solid modelling or assembly.
Editing of drawings. Dimensioning of drawings. Adding of tolerances to drawings.
Editing of dimensions and texts. Adding of explanations. Creating of basic features.
bibliography: Catia V5R15 ile modelleme, A. Özdemir, M. Turgut, Z. Tek, 2004.
